policy: Unique normalized permanent B clauses in original first-occurrence order. No selector for an empty list. An empty clause is a member. Freeze each group's entire signed payload. Reuse every old group whose complete payload belongs to current B. Re-cover uncovered inputs in first-occurrence order. QueryDescriptor is an independent immutable scope with one query guard in grouped arms; native assumptions retain polarity. R2, whole-graph EPOCH, dynamic CO, native CDCL and database policy fixed.
reset: Solve P0 in its own grouped solver. After receipt, authenticate P1 with the same mapping and compute the identical active partition. Create a second fresh solver in P1 native-local variable order; install active groups only (kept groups in registry/member order, then new groups), current epoch and query only. Carry no trail, clauses, activities or obsolete variables. Charge validating and constructing the partition, destruction/recreation, and P1 setup to this arm.
limits: Same PI-0 frozen source/configuration and PI-1 sealed B/Q/T/SC models, certified signed matches, CPU 0, timeout and AS cap per side. One serial timed P0→P1 per arm/case; P1 and its correspondence are supplied after P0 result. NativeLedger off, R2 common counters, identical control recording. No detailed trace during timings. Retain failures and negative results.
audit: One separate ledger-on replay per arm and case. Collect length/selector joint distributions from live native clauses and units, allocator/watcher snapshots; no reduce predicate stream. Check controls, inputs, native counters, complete properties, SAT assignments and event orders match timed arms. Record actual guarded signed literals passed to addClause_ before simplification plus compact immutable group members/occurrences and enabled signed controls; independently reconstruct B and Q and check in local coordinates. Separate positive, negative and fault-injected controls on small models.
offline: Before native implementation, inventory the four sealed pairs in one pass per side, certify signed proposals against the complete interface and events, count full/partial/absent old groups, fine/shared group membership, uncovered reinstallation, new groups, selectors, assumptions and epoch retention. P0 partition created before inspecting P1.
stock: Report same-host accepted stock full verification walls. Also run one same-model unguarded cold transaction per side/case with the frozen pristine native kernel control if capable; include parse/installation/solve, separate source verification boundary.
decision: A repaired SAT→UNSAT case requires P1 Grouped-Persistent at least 5% and 0.2 s faster than Fine-Persistent, AND below stock full P1 wall. Separately report comparison to Grouped-Reset-active. Historical fib-snapshot-11 kept INCOMPLETE_UNWINDING, excluded from repair signal. Single observations, no end-to-end speedup claim.
stop: READY_FOR_REVIEW, no PI-2, alternate group widths, selector heuristics or changes to native deletion/minimization.
